text:
cassie: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region spike — I'm still seeing long-tail TLS handshake retries between us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Need owners and timelines for the remediation items. cc @omar @jun @maya

omar: I can own the routing rule change for the LB. Will validate with a 5% canary and smoke tests. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

jun: I'll own telemetry/alerts alignment. Need to add a regression eval and make sure our retries metric isn't getting sampled away. Tentative ETA: 72h.

maya: I'll handle the fallback/backpressure config (dedicated capacity + token-bucket on handshakes). Planning a staged rollout, ETA 5d.

omar: quick log snippet I pulled: 
```
2026-03-22T02:14:08Z lb-router us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 TLS handshake timeout retries=12 backend=lb-ps-3 conn_id=0x7f8a
```

jun: query I'll use to baseline retries: 
```
select count(*) from lb_conn where retries > 1 and src_region='us-east-1' and dst_region='eu-west-1' and ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

maya: action item created: SRE-2342 assign Omar/Jun for the immediate work, I'll own SRE-2343 for fallback policy. Adding canary plan to the ticket.

ops-bot: Created task <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2342|SRE-2342> assigned to Omar, Jun. Due: 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC.

omar: starting canary deploy now: `deploy --service lb-router --canary 5% --image sha:abc123` — I'll post results in ~30m.

jun: plan for alerting: add alert "lb.cross_region_retries.rate" with threshold = 5x baseline over 10m, attach runbook link, and add a suppression window for planned canaries.

maya: note on recurrence pattern: these retries tend to follow cross-region scaling events + small cipher-suite mismatches. I'm adding a test in the CI matrix to exercise ciphers during scale-ups.

cassie: Summary of owners/timelines: 1) Routing rule fix (Omar) – 48h 2) Telemetry + alerts (Jun) – 72h 3) Fallback/backpressure (Maya) – 5d 4) Post-deploy probe + CI test (Ops) – 1w. Reconvene in 24h for status. If anyone needs to change ETA, update SRE-2342 thread. :thumbsup:
